title: Oil of Accuracy
summary: Spend a Bonus Action and consume the oil to give attacks with your active weapon set +2 to hit for 10 turns. Thrown attacks receive no bonus.

fields.Weapon set: Coat the active melee or ranged set. When dual wielding, this coats both weapons in the selected set. Switch sets and apply another dose to coat the other set.
fields.Attack rolls: +2 with the coated weapon on eligible attacks.
fields.Limits: One coating per weapon set, including dipping effects. Throwing the coated weapon gives no attack bonus. Throwing the bottle creates no coating area.
fields.Crafting: Combine Ashes of Daggerroot and any Salt through Alchemy.
fields.Base value: 20 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Creative use: Coat your melee set before a fight where both weapons will see use, or choose the ranged set if your opening depends on landing a difficult shot.

changes: Replaced the index-only description with reviewed BG3 gameplay facts and source links. Preserved the existing ID, generic art, and merchant estimates.
